messages:
Amelia: Heads up — deploy-bot blocked the publish for release/2024.09 (image: `redwood/runtime:2024.09.2`) due to an OCI label mismatch with the attestation. We need a quick call on rollback vs retag.

deploy-bot: publish rejected: provenance verification failed. mismatch in OCI labels: `licenses` expected: "Apache-2.0" found: "MIT". image digest: sha256:9a1b2c3d4e5f... action: hold.

Santiago: which registry/region? ECR us-west-2? any replication in flight?

Amelia: yes ECR us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 mirror. Tag is `redwood/runtime:2024.09.2` (digest above). Build logs show label set at build step: `--label licenses=MIT` (we used a new base image this week).

Ravi: likely change in base image metadata. Quick options: 1) rebuild with `--label licenses=Apache-2.0` and republish with new tag, then attach new attestation; 2) retag existing digest and create a delegating attestation (we require matching labels, so attestation must match image metadata); 3) rollback to previous pinned digest in the release pipeline.

Harper: release window is open for another 45m. If rebuild + attest will block us past the change window. Rolling back to previous digest is fastest. Thoughts on risk?

Amelia: previous pinned digest is sha256:7f6e5d4c3b2a..., that's already validated and mirrored. If we rollback, we should update the release notes and file a follow-up to fix the base image metadata and CI.

Santiago: ✅ we can roll back canary to the pinned digest in the next 10m. I'll coordinate the deploy. @Harper want a quick approval?

Harper: approve rollback to sha256:7f6e5d4c3b2a... for safety. Postmortem required. :thumbsup:

Amelia: doing the rollback now. Also filing an infra ticket to add an automated check in build pipeline to validate `licenses` label against attestation before publish.

ci-bot: triggered pipeline: release/canary rollback -> deploying digest sha256:7f6e5d4c3b2a... to canary (job #4821).

Santiago: canary looks healthy so far (logs green). Will promote to stable after 15m smoke.

Ravi: after release window, we should fix the Dockerfile: either strip license label inheritance from base image or explicitly set `LABEL licenses=Apache-2.0` during build and run a local attest step. Also add a quick unit test in build CI: `inspect-oci-labels` that fails early.

Amelia: agreed. I'll create the ticket and attach the offending base image digest + suggested patch. Ticket will include commands we used:

```
# quick retest locally
docker build --label licenses=Apache-2.0 -t redwood/runtime:2024.09.2-fix .
cosign attest --key $ATTEST_KEY redwood/runtime:2024.09.2-fix
# push and request publish
```

Harper: thanks. After stable promotion, include a short note in the release blurb: "rollback to previous runtime image due to OCI label mismatch; follow-up patch planned".

Amelia: will add the note and link the infra ticket. Closing this thread when stable is promoted.

ci-bot: release/canary promote -> stable promoted (job #4823).

Santiago: stable verified. marking release as deployed.

Amelia: closing — postmortem template created and assigned to @Ravi.
